claw.relation: Standalone83 includes12T gear and2 modeled rubber bands but no shaft/collar/motor; embedded88 adds motor1, shaft1, collar1 and2 additional long screws. Matching counts/topology do not certify unchanged geometry between2018/2020/2023.
claw.completeNativeGeometry: Both native STEP files contain separately named rigid claw pieces, pivot hardware, washers/Section010 pieces, gear and placements. No invented internal placeholders required.
limitations: Section010 and Washer_Instruction remain source CAD names, not guessed official procurement categories.

Standalone model has no4x pitch shaft or rubber collar despite current kit contents; not a complete packaged procurement BOM.
Rev6 manual does not publish internal component revisions; exact Rev6 match remains unverified.

geometry.measurementMethod: OpenCascade via cadquery-ocp8.0.1.1.0 STEPCAF import; native placements; BRepBndLib.AddOptimal no triangulation/no tolerance expansion. Values are CAD-derived nominal research measurements, not toleranced drawing certifications.

motorPairedInsertAxes.mountingRole: Inference supported by paired CAD inserts and official two #8-32 statement; radius is source unthreaded CAD cylinder, not a thread/tap specification.

bomReconciliation.finding: Live starter-kit contents explicitly includes1 V5 Claw Assembly linked to276-6010; manual omitted it. Native CAD now supplies internals. This resolves discoverability, not Rev6 internal revision.

Current kit and historical Rev1 inventory agree3x300+1x600+1x900; Rev6 page3 swaps300/900 quantities. Rev6 step41 and Rev1 step41 also reverse arm/claw lengths; no single authoritative correction obtained.
Current kit lists6 0x2; CAD root has4 occurrences228-2500-086 and historical step20 uses4 pins228-3943-086. Exact type/revision unresolved.
CAD root has27 .375 screws,29 nuts,7 .125 spacers, agreeing Rev6 explicit step totals rather than inventory30/30/8. CAD count corroboration is not permission to declare leftovers spares.

Current kit lists4 outside the Claw Assembly; claw CAD standalone contains2 internal long screws; embedded claw contains4 long screws including motor attachment. Distinguish kit bundled components from manual callouts before summing.

Otherwise restrictions include modifying, transforming and creating derivative works.

rights.application: Public product controls explicitly offer STEP download and CAD preview, supporting private native CAD inspection. CAD-to-mesh conversion for a separate app is not expressly identified; request written scope-specific permission rather than infer a conversion license from private/promotional branding guidance.
rights.brandingWarning: Branding guidance alone is not a CAD license. No external asset shipped or converted mesh produced.
rights.embeddedFileLicense: All3 ZIPs contain1 STEP each, no README/LICENSE. No copyright/license/redistribution wording found in inspected STEP text; empty header author/organization fields are not a grant.

licensedAlternatives.result: License endpoint404; repository README gives library/import instructions, not explicit asset license or VEX rights chain. Not cleared as a redistributable alternative.
licensedAlternatives.search: Targeted VEX claw Creative Commons/CC-BY search found no verified faithful licensed claw match. Absence in inspected results is not proof none exists.

faithfulPaths.available: Official2018 manual Rev1 + same-era April2018 full engineering STEP + native claw internals; keep model transforms/hardware references and historical wiring.
prerequisites: Do not equate separate CAD/manual Rev1 labels; complete instance-by-instance drawing/placement comparison or obtain VEX confirmation.
Obtain CAD-to-runtime-mesh permission even for private local app if relying on conversion; request public grant separately only if deployment intended.

faithfulPaths.available: Existing Rev6 manual plus recovered full BREP as engineering reference
prerequisites: Obtain VEX confirmation of unchanged component geometry or revised STEP matching276-6009-750 Rev6, particularly step28 cut and claw internals.
Obtain exact notch profile and revision-compatible cable/pin clarification.
Obtain scoped CAD-conversion/redistribution permission as needed.

faithfulPaths.available: Published motor envelope/thread/socket facts, manual lengths and recovered native dimensioned BREP features support real engineering shapes rather than generic boxes.
prerequisites: Do not copy mesh/CAD topology and call it independent. Use independently recorded factual dimensions or obtain2D drawings and document provenance.
Motor shape/mounts and each claw link/gear/washer/hole/profile require measured source coordinates, not nominal bounding boxes.
Seek legal clarification of dimension extraction/independent-authoring scope under site transformation restrictions and any separate design rights; no blanket clearance is asserted.
